description.html: Dimensions of 32x20x25 cm give 640 cm² of floor and 16 liters. It is a narrow, shallow terrarium that fits on a shelf 20 cm deep. The back is taken up by a 3D background, so the interior looks finished even before you add decor. Air is exchanged through mesh vents.

This is a size for raising juveniles. A newly hatched leopard gecko or a juvenile corn snake finds food easily here and has a hide at each end, some twenty centimeters apart. Young crested, gargoyle and day geckos use the background to climb up to a height of 25 cm. Smaller lizard species can stay longer, depending on the size of the adult.

If you need several such terrariums for a breeding rack, we build them in identical dimensions so they stand side by side. Slightly longer models are the 34x20x28 and 35x20x25. We ship by courier to all parts of Serbia. Sizes made to order need 7 to 14 days, and you choose the film pattern before the build.
